Senses.Explanation: The concrete point at which a teacher works on people's behalf, asked after, shown, and denied in the records' own words. Fachang Yiyu asks the assembly whether Fachang has any such move at all and answers with the one pill that settles every illness, Foyan Qingyuan asks whether the mountain monk has one and warns that either answer would bury somebody, Yuanwu Keqin praises the heaped-up helping moves Xuedou spends on the first case, Yuanwu Keqin again, in the raised old-case collection, locates Mazu's helping move inside the illness-bed exchange, and Ying'an Tanhua offers to show the assembly his own by throwing the staff to the ground. Fushi Tongxian grants Qianfeng and Yunmen each a helping move and then rules both imperfect at second inspection, Juelang Daosheng asks whether stepping straight down from the seat leaves an intimate one, Baiyu Jingsi asks whether his dragon-flower raising has one and pays it out as a ballad, Zhe'an Jingfan sets Dongshan's three roads and Yunmen's one word aside, asking whether any helping move remains in his own Cao Shan summer, and Hansong Zhicao asks whether his greens-and-rice lodge keeps one and warns the assembly not to feed the rice into their nostrils.
